Castle Valley Inn
A Bed and Breakfast Just 30 Minutes From Moab
Welcome to Castle Valley Inn
Located just 16 miles outside Moab, Castle Valley Inn is ideally situated for exploring some of Utah's most beautiful national parks. Our bed and breakfast offers the perfect balance of comfort and adventure, providing both convenient access to nearby attractions and a quiet retreat for rest and relaxation.
Our property sits on 5 acres of lovely manicured grounds and includes a delicious, homemade breakfast each morning. It also features spacious guest rooms, a large deck, a relaxing hot tub, and unparalleled views of the surrounding landscape. These amenities along with our exceptional hospitality set us apart from traditional Castle Valley, Utah hotels and keep our guests returning year after year.

Dark Night Skies!
With little to no light pollution, the night sky at Castle Valley, UT is perfect for stargazing. Spot constellations, planets, and falling stars all with the naked eye. Come discover the magic of southeastern Utah at night!
Learn More
Castle Valley Inn is perfectly located for accessing the area's best attractions and restaurants. Explore the many things to do in Moab, visit Canyonlands and Arches National Parks, walk with the dinosaurs at Moab Giants, and then see the real-life fossils, footprints, and track marks at Mill Canyon Dinosaur Tracksite.
When you've finished your day's adventures, come back to Castle Valley Inn for a night of stargazing and rest.

About castle valley inn
Our bed and breakfast near Moab provides a perfect balance of comfort and adventure. With a hot homemade breakfast each morning, delightful outdoor spaces, modern amenities, and beautiful views, we offer much more than traditional Castle Valley, Utah hotels.
Castle Valley Inn sits on 5 acres of orchards, lawns, and gardens all designed to provide you with peace, tranquility, and an opportunity to disconnect from the rush of everyday life.
our Property
Learn More
Welcome to Castle Valley Inn in Castle Valley, Utah! We've made sure you can start each morning with our regionally-inspired breakfast and a cup of organic, freshly-ground coffee or pot of tea.
We look forwarding to providing you with our local knowledge of southeastern Utah, so you can spend your day exploring. Then come back to the inn where you can enjoy our lawns and orchards, relax in our spacious hot tub or hammock, and spot native wildlife such as mule deer, wild cottontail rabbits, or ring-necked pheasants.
If you're still up for a stroll after your day's adventures, you'll love our loop path. It's especially peaceful at night when you walk beneath Utah's magnificent canopy of stars.
We can't wait to meet you!
- Scott and Jennifer Osumi

Accommodations
Relax With Modern Amenities And Rustic Design
castle valley inn accommodations
All of our accommodations come with Wi-Fi, Roku Smart TVs, private bathrooms, comfortable beds, fresh linens and bathrobes, air conditioning and fans, small refrigerators, and beautiful views.
Cabins and Rooms
Explore our cabins, bungalows, rooms, and suites. We know you'll find one you love!
